title: Extemporaneous
summary: EXTEMPORA'NEOUS, adjective [Latin extemporaneus; ex and tempus, time.] Composed, performed or uttered at the time the subject occurs, without previous study; unpremeditated; as an extemporaneous addre

inlines.v: EXTEMPORA'NEOUS, adjective [Latin extemporaneus; ex and tempus, time.] Composed, performed or uttered at the time the subject occurs, without previous study; unpremeditated; as an extemporaneous address; an extemporaneous production; an extemporaneous prescription.
